description: This file defines the I18NImportErrorDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the I18NImportError entity, providing methods to set related entities such as language, error, and employee based on identifiers.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for I18NImportError providing methods to associate language, error, and employee entities based on IDs or names.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Sets the language string reference in I18NImportError based on the provided language string ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Sets the language reference in I18NImportError based on the provided language ID.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Sets the error reference in I18NImportError based on the provided error name.

methods.name: setImportedEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the imported employee in I18NImportError based on the employee number.
